cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
path='controller.py'
src=open(path).read()
old_start = src.index("    def negative_cycle(self, flow):")
old_end = src.index("    def _extract(self, pred, start):")
new = '''    def negative_cycle(self, flow):
        """Return (cycle, distances).

        ``cycle`` is the residual arc list of a negative cycle or None; the
        distances are the feasible residual potentials when no cycle exists.
        """
        n = self.n
        adj = self.adj
        res_to = self.res_to
        res_cost = self.res_cost
        res_arc = self.res_arc
        res_dir = self.res_dir
        arcs = self.arcs
        dist = [0] * n
        pred = [-1] * n
        length = [0] * n
        queued = [True] * n
        queue = deque(range(n))
        while queue:
            u = queue.popleft()
            queued[u] = False
            du = dist[u]
            step = length[u] + 1
            for edge in adj[u]:
                index = res_arc[edge]
                if res_dir[edge] > 0:
                    room = arcs[index][3] - flow[index]
                else:
                    room = flow[index] - arcs[index][2]
                if room <= 0:
                    continue
                v = res_to[edge]
                candidate = du + res_cost[edge]
                if candidate < dist[v]:
                    dist[v] = candidate
                    pred[v] = edge
                    length[v] = step
                    if step >= n:
                        return self._extract(pred, v), dist
                    if not queued[v]:
                        queued[v] = True
                        queue.append(v)
        return None, dist

'''
src = src[:old_start] + new + src[old_end:]
open(path,'w').write(src)
